run_GetTestsForAllIterations: run the test program with flags and return a list of tests per iteration
run_GetTestCases: run GetTestCases to extract unique test case names from a list of full test names
run_CalculateTestLists: run CalculateTestLists to populate global test lists for all, active, filtered, and shuffled scenarios
test_GTestShuffleUnitTest: test that shuffling preserves test count, changes order, and does not interleave test cases
review_GetTestsForAllIterations: review GetTestsForAllIterations which parses test output lines starting with dashes into iteration groups
